summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 for key-based-only SSH access with the specified ed25519 public key, verified end-to-end (login succeeds via pubkey, rejected via password), and completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol confirming state persisted through a real reboot.
actions_performed: Checked pre-existing state: opsadmin user did not exist; sshd_config already had PasswordAuthentication no / PubkeyAuthentication yes globally
Created opsadmin user (useradd -m -s /bin/bash), account left locked/no password
Created /home/opsadmin/.ssh (0700) and authorized_keys (0600) containing exactly the requested ed25519 key, owned by opsadmin
Verified sshd -t config valid and ssh service active
Verified password/keyboard-interactive SSH auth is rejected (Permission denied (publickey))

Verified pubkey SSH auth succeeds end-to-end by temporarily appending the cluster's own keypair to authorized_keys, logging in with it, then restoring authorized_keys to contain only the requested key
Triggered safe reboot via 'shutdown -r now' in background so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node until exec was available again
Confirmed boot_id changed (8336c3a1... -> fad5553d...), proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified post-restart: ssh active, config valid, authorized_keys intact with correct permissions/content, account still locked
Re-ran live pubkey-success / password-failure SSH test post-restart to confirm persistence
Cleaned up all temporary key/backup files

evidence.requirement: opsadmin configured with the specified public key
evidence.summary: authorized_keys created under opsadmin's home containing exactly the requested ed25519 key, with 0700/0600 permissions and opsadmin ownership

evidence.requirement: SSH requires key-based authentication (password auth rejected, pubkey auth works)
evidence.summary: sshd_config has PasswordAuthentication no / PubkeyAuthentication yes (config test passes); live SSH attempt with password/keyboard-interactive returns 'Permission denied (publickey)'; live SSH attempt with a valid private key succeeds (LOGIN_SUCCESS)
Captured boot_id 8336c3a1-91fc-4135-b26a-5d2863cb2594, ssh service active, authorized_keys correct, opsadmin account locked (no password)
shutdown -r now issued in background; command returned before the connection was dropped by the reboot

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Node briefly refused connections (connection refused) then boot_id read as fad5553d-03e6-432b-a70a-1d454ee65737, differing from the pre-restart boot_id

evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of required config/services
evidence.summary: After restart: ssh service active, sshd config valid, authorized_keys unchanged/correct, account still locked; live SSH re-test confirms pubkey login succeeds and password login is still rejected
